name: f-couch
prompt: She takes a slow sip of coffee while reading the itinerary on her laptop, smiles, sets the mug on her knee and scrolls with two fingers on the trackpad. The dog in the background lifts its head and yawns. Morning sun, gentle handheld drift. The laptop screen content stays exactly as it is: sharp, still and unchanged. Realistic, natural motion, no text overlays, no logos.
